mapper.sql: u.user_id, u.email, u.name, u.phone, u.dept_id, d.dept_nm, u.position_id, p.position_nm, u.role_cd, r.role_nm, u.hire_date, u.bank_cd, u.bank_account, u.use_yn, u.pwd_fail_cnt, u.locked_yn, u.locked_at, u.pwd_changed_at, u.pwd_expire_at, u.last_login_at, u.last_login_ip, u.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_user u LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_position p ON p.position_id = u.position_id LEFT JOIN gw_role r ON r.role_cd = u.role_cd WHERE u.email = #{email} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT FROM gw_user u LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_position p ON p.position_id = u.position_id LEFT JOIN gw_role r ON r.role_cd = u.role_cd WHERE u.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_user (email, password_hash, name, phone, dept_id, position_id, role_cd, hire_date, bank_cd, bank_account, use_yn, pwd_changed_at, pwd_expire_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{deptId}, #{positionId}, #{roleCd}, #{hireDate}, #{bankCd}, #{bankAccount}, 'Y', COALESCE(#{pwdChangedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{pwdExpireAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_user SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, dept_id = #{deptId}, position_id = #{positionId}, role_cd = #{roleCd}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, bank_cd = #{bankCd}, bank_account = #{bankAccount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE gw_user SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_login_ip = #{ip}, pwd_fail_cnt = 0 WHERE user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE gw_user SET pwd_fail_cnt = pwd_fail_cnt + 1, locked_yn = CASE WHEN pwd_fail_cnt + 1 >= #{maxFail} THEN 'Y' ELSE locked_yn END, locked_at = CASE WHEN pwd_fail_cnt + 1 >= #{maxFail} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE locked_at END WHERE email = #{email}
UPDATE gw_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, pwd_changed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE gw_user SET use_yn = #{useYn} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE gw_user SET role_cd = #{roleCd} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM gw_user u LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_position p ON p.position_id = u.position_id LEFT JOIN gw_role r ON r.role_cd = u.role_cd WHERE u.dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY COALESCE(p.level_no, 0) DESC, u.name

SELECT FROM gw_user u LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_position p ON p.position_id = u.position_id LEFT JOIN gw_role r ON r.role_cd = u.role_cd WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY u.dept_id NULLS LAST, COALESCE(p.level_no, 0) DESC, u.name
